Former housing official Catherine Fitts joins Danny Jones to claim that twenty-one trillion dollars in black budget funds a rogue breakaway civilization. Fitts once served in the US housing agency. She has tracked missing state funds for years.

Fitts explains how she found the gaps in the books and where she thinks the cash went. She argues a hidden group now lives off the grid with tech far past ours. Jones asks what proof can be shown in the open. Listeners get her full case at length. The library files the talk as an archive record of her claims.
